properties.name: U8206/26 / EGAR
properties.originalText:
ROTHERA IS NOT AVBL TO ALL FIXED AND ROTARY WING TRAFFIC DURING 
BAS DASH 7 POINT OF SAFE RETURN OPS. IT IS MANDATORY FOR COMMANDERS 
OF ALL INBOUND AIRCRAFT TO CONTACT ROTHERA OPS ON THE DAY OF AND
BEFORE DEPARTURE TO ASCERTAIN DETAILS OF RWY AVAILABILITY. ANY
AIRCRAFT ARRIVING DURING PERIODS OF BAS DASH 7 POINT OF SAFE RETURN
OPS WILL NOT BE GIVEN LANDING PERMISSION UNDER ANY CIRCUMSTANCES.
ALL AIRCRAFT ARRIVALS MUST PLAN TO ARRIVE OUTSIDE OF BAS DASH 7
POINT OF SAFE RETURN PERIODS. FOR MORE INFORMATION CONTACT ROTHERA
OPS: ROPS(AT)BAS.AC.UK PHONE: 
+441223221670 OR +441223221673
